File contract: Write solution.rs with the public function at module scope; use only the standard library.
Required API: pub fn token_bucket_trace(capacity: i32, initial: i32, refill: i32, costs: &[i32]) -> Option<Vec<i32>>
Behavior: Start with initial tokens. Before every request except the first, refill and cap at capacity. If cost is affordable, spend it and emit remaining tokens; otherwise keep state and emit -(available+1). Reject invalid negative settings/costs or initial above capacity; empty costs succeeds.
Visible example: capacity 5, initial 3, refill 2, costs [2,5,1,4] return [1,-4,4,1]; -4 records rejection with 3 available tokens.

Buggy source to repair:

pub fn token_bucket_trace(capacity:i32,initial:i32,refill:i32,costs:&[i32])->Option<Vec<i32>>{let mut tokens=initial;Some(costs.iter().map(|&c|{tokens=(tokens+refill).min(capacity)-c;tokens}).collect())}

reference.code: pub fn token_bucket_trace(capacity:i32,initial:i32,refill:i32,costs:&[i32])->Option<Vec<i32>>{if capacity<0||initial<0||initial>capacity||refill<0||costs.iter().any(|&x|x<0){return None}let mut tokens=initial;let mut out=Vec::new();for(i,&cost)in costs.iter().enumerate(){if i>0{tokens=(tokens+refill).min(capacity)}if cost<=tokens{tokens-=cost;out.push(tokens)}else{out.push(-tokens-1)}}Some(out)}
